name: What is the typical timeline for constructing a multigenerational living solution?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical timeline for constructing a multigenerational living solution?

acceptedAnswer.text: The construction timeline for a multigenerational living solution, such as an ADU or home addition, generally ranges from 6 to 12 months, though complex projects can take longer. This includes design, permitting, and construction phases. The permitting process alone can take several weeks to a few months, depending on local San Diego county regulations and review times. Actual construction usually takes 3 to 6 months. We work to streamline each phase to complete your project efficiently while maintaining quality.
acceptedAnswer.description: Construction of a multigenerational living solution typically takes 6-12 months, including design, permitting, and building phases.
